final: WITH actor_counts AS (SELECT actor_id, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film_actor GROUP BY actor_id), total AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT film_id) AS distinct_films FROM film_actor), ratios AS (SELECT a.actor_id, a.film_count, 1.0 * a.film_count / NULLIF(t.distinct_films, 0) AS film_share FROM actor_counts AS a CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE t.distinct_films IS NOT NULL), mean_share AS (SELECT AVG(film_share) AS value FROM ratios) SELECT r.actor_id, r.film_count, r.film_share, r.film_share - m.value AS difference FROM ratios AS r CROSS JOIN mean_share AS m WHERE m.value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
